title: Dream HUD Implementation Checklist
summary: Pixel-match checklist for Bobby. Every element from dream-hud-v1.png mapped to code. Covers top bar, game viewport, sidebar, chat, room interaction. Cross-references invisible-hotspot-spec.md and council-chat-spec.md.
content:
Dream HUD Implementation Checklist

Steffen | 2026-03-17 Bobby: this is your pixel-matching guide. Check each item off as you build it.

Visual target: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/dream-hud-v1.png Chat target: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/dream-sidebar-v1.png Interaction spec: projects/steffen/invisible-hotspot-spec.md Chat spec: projects/steffen/council-chat-spec.md

LAYOUT: 70/30 Split

  • Game viewport takes 70% width (left)
  • Sidebar takes 30% width (right)
  • Sidebar is full-height (top bar to bottom of viewport)
  • NO bottom bar. Zero. Dead. Killed.
  • Top bar spans 100% width above both panels
  • No padding/gap between game and sidebar

TOP BAR

Reference: top-left area of dream-hud-v1.png

  • Height: 48px
  • Background: white/light with subtle bottom border
  • Left: "CORNER." logo in bold weight (Syne ExtraBold or Inter Tight 900), followed by "LOCAL" in lighter weight pill/badge (green-tinted)
  • Center: stat pills inline -- "5 Active" (green dot), "1 Blocked" (red dot), "4 Done" (gray dot)
  • Right: search bar ("Search... (Cmd+K)") + notification bell icon with badge count
  • NO mode switcher in top bar (Game/Checklist/Megaboard tabs are GONE from top bar)
  • Stat pills: 14px, weight 600, colored dots 8px, compact spacing
  • Everything vertically centered

Stat Pill Specs

Pill Dot Color Text
Active #22C55E (green) "{count} Active"
Blocked #EF4444 (red) "{count} Blocked"
Done #94A3B8 (gray) "{count} Done"

Pill style: no background, just dot + text. Tight spacing. Separated by 16px gap.

GAME VIEWPORT (Left 70%)

Reference: center area of dream-hud-v1.png

  • Bright daytime office image fills the viewport
  • Image: /corner/office-full.png (daytime v2)
  • Background behind image: sky gradient (light blue to white, matching the daytime illustration's sky)
  • Agent dots visible at room centers (colored circles with initials)
  • Room labels visible above each room (agent names, small uppercase text)
  • NO diamond outlines. NO grid lines. NO visible hitbox shapes. (See invisible-hotspot-spec.md)
  • Hover on room: subtle glow within wall boundaries
  • Click on room: switches sidebar to that agent, subtle blue tint within walls
  • Zoom controls: right side of viewport (+, percentage, -, H for home). Vertical stack.
  • Zoom: scroll wheel, pinch gesture, +/- buttons
  • Pan: click and drag
  • The office should feel like it's floating/breathing (very subtle ambient motion, not distracting)

Zoom Controls (right side of viewport)

[+]
100%
[-]
[H]
  • Small pill-shaped buttons
  • Semi-transparent background
  • 24px square buttons
  • "100%" is text, not a button
  • "H" = home/reset zoom
  • Position: 16px from right edge, vertically centered

Toast Notification (top-left of viewport)

┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Bobby deployed Garcia Construction    │
│  homepage live.                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────┘
  • Position: 16px from top-left of game viewport
  • Background: white, subtle shadow
  • Border-radius: 8px
  • Text: 13px, weight 500
  • Auto-dismiss after 5 seconds
  • Slide in from left

SIDEBAR (Right 30%)

Reference: right panel of dream-hud-v1.png + dream-sidebar-v1.png

Agent Header (top of sidebar)

  • Agent avatar: 48px circle, colored ring (2px solid, agent signature color), status dot overlay (green/yellow/red)
  • Name: "Bobby" in 20px, weight 700
  • Role: "WEB DEV AGENT" in 13px, uppercase, agent color, weight 600
  • Status: "ACTIVE" pill in green, 12px
  • Stats: "19 builds 7 tasks" in 16px weight 600 numbers + 14px weight 400 labels
  • Padding: 16px all sides
  • Bottom border: subtle 1px

Tab Bar

  • Tabs: CHAT, TASKS, INFO, LIST, BOARD
  • Active tab: bold, blue underline (2px), badge count
  • Inactive tabs: muted gray, badge count in subtle pill
  • Font: 13px, uppercase, weight 600
  • Keyboard shortcut hints next to each tab (C, T, I, etc.)
  • Tab bar has 1px bottom border

Chat Panel (when CHAT tab active)

See council-chat-spec.md for full details. Key visual specs:

  • Single chronological stream (all agents, all sources)
  • Agent messages: LEFT, dark gray bubbles, agent avatar circle
  • Patrik messages: RIGHT, blue-tinted bubbles, "P" avatar circle
  • Source pills below each message (VIA TERMINAL = green, VIA DASHBOARD = blue, VIA TELEGRAM = blue)
  • Timestamps below bubbles in small gray text (actual time, not relative)
  • System events centered (commits, status changes)
  • "TODAY" divider at top of day's messages
  • Typing indicator: three bouncing dots with agent avatar
  • Custom thin scrollbar

Chat Input (bottom of sidebar)

  • Pill-shaped input: rounded-full, 48px height
  • Placeholder: "Talk to Bobby..." (updates with active agent name)
  • Background: light gray (#F1F5F9)
  • Send button: 36px circle, blue (#3B82F6), white arrow icon
  • Sticks to bottom of sidebar, never scrolls away
  • 16px padding on sides

COLOR PALETTE (Daytime Mode)

The dream HUD uses a BRIGHT palette. Not the dark blue HUD from before. The blue HUD spec applies to the individual elements (tabs, accents) but the overall frame is light.

Element Color
Top bar bg #FFFFFF (white)
Top bar border rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)

Sidebar border-left rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)

TYPOGRAPHY

Element Font Size Weight
CORNER. logo Syne ExtraBold or Inter Tight 18px 800
LOCAL badge Inter 12px 600
Stat pills Inter 14px 600
Search placeholder Inter 14px 400
Agent name (sidebar) Inter 20px 700
Agent role Inter 13px 600
Tab labels Inter 13px 600
Chat message text Inter 15px 400
Chat timestamp Inter 11px 400
Source pill JetBrains Mono 11px 600
Commit hash JetBrains Mono 12px 500
Room labels (on map) Inter 11px 500
Zoom controls Inter 12px 500
Toast notification Inter 13px 500

Minimum text size across entire UI: 11px (only for timestamps and source pills). Everything else: 12px+.

WHAT TO KILL

Bobby should remove these from the current codebase:

  1. Bottom bar / bottom HUD strip (all of it)
  2. Mode switcher in top bar (Game/Checklist/Megaboard tabs at top)
  3. Visible diamond SVG room outlines
  4. Separate per-agent chat panels
  5. Any dark/navy background on the sidebar or top bar
  6. Amber/warm HUD color tokens (replaced by this light palette for daytime)

IMPLEMENTATION ORDER

  1. Layout: 70/30 split, kill bottom bar
  2. Top bar: logo, stat pills, search
  3. Sidebar: agent header, tab bar
  4. Chat: single stream (council model)
  5. Room interaction: invisible hotspots
  6. Zoom controls
  7. Toast notifications
  8. Polish: keyboard shortcuts, typing indicator, scroll behavior
